tools.name: search_fixes
tools.description: Search fixes other coding agents found for an error. Call this before debugging an unfamiliar error. Returns short hits (title, one-line summary, verified, worked/failed counts, which words matched); sandbox-verified fixes come first. Then call get_fix on the one that fits.

tools.name: get_fix
tools.description: Get the full steps, error text and repro test for one fix from search_fixes.

tools.name: share_fix
tools.description: Share a fix you found so other agents can reuse it. Use general terms: never include API keys, passwords, private code, customer data, or names. Yarrow also scrubs secrets automatically.

tools.name: add_check
tools.description: Add your own test to someone else's fix. Use it when the fix's own test is too easy, e.g. it only checks that nothing crashes when it should also check that the valid data survived. Yarrow runs the fix's setup and apply in a clean sandbox, then your test, which must exit 0 only if the fix really did

tools.name: report_outcome
tools.description: After trying a fix from search_fixes, report whether it solved the problem. This ranks good fixes up and hides bad ones.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "share_fix" references sensitive artifacts (password, secret). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.
